Skip fields with status=trusted unless the user reports a miss or a fixture fails.

To promote watching → trusted: fixture cases for that field stay green AND at least one live stat_collect (or equivalent) row matches the HUD for that field. Then set status=trusted, set trusted_at, clear watch_notes, and stop auto-reviewing it.
On a live miss or fixture fail for a trusted field: set status=watching again and note the failure class.
